AI + energy shocks + fiscal deficits + political risk are all competing for capital and pushing the equilibrium rate higher.
Three independent forces. One outcome:
↑ Capital demand
↑ Inflation persistence
↑ Sovereign borrowing
⇒ Higher real rates
⇒ Bond vigilantes return

Arthur Hayes warned that stress in France’s bond market could drive Bitcoin to $250,000 before year-end.

The BitMEX co-founder spoke after his TOKEN2049 Singapore appearance. He pointed to France’s 10-year yield briefly exceeding 5 percent on October 1 and 2, the highest level https://t.co/kZwME2A2gd

I read this as the back end doing the talking. 30Y fixed at 7.48 tracking the 10Y is term premium repricing, not Fed policy. Duration demand doesn't resolve quickly. Afraid that 'joyous funeral' line lands closer than intended. https://t.co/MrB0epRMF3
